The '''Coordinator Droid CO-41''' was a model of [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]]. A number of CO-41 droids worked in one section of the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coordinator Droid CO-41 appears a type of enemy in the Bounty Hunter class mission "Chaos at the Droid Factory" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
